messages:
Jin: Draft for changelog — embeddings streaming deprecation. Putting the draft here for docs review and SDK snippet changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/345

Maria: quick skim — can we call out migration steps + a one-line code sample? also add a known-issue note about micro-batch variance :thinking_face:

Jin: sure, here's a compact draft to paste into the relnotes page:
- Deprecate `embeddings.stream` (streaming embeddings) in favor of `embeddings.create` (batch embeddings). Effective 2026-05-01.
- Migration: replace streaming generator with batching via `input` lists. Use `batch_id` to preserve ordering and for easier troubleshooting.
- Known issue: models may return slightly different vectors for very small micro-batches (<4 items). Recommendation: prefer batch sizes >=8 for stability.

Samir: product sign-off on the date. Add a line about Dedicated customers getting a 90-day grace period and a migration support offer.

Liam: small edit to the SDK snippet — current example uses a streaming generator, we should show a minimal before/after. I'll drop a snippet here, please confirm formatting for the docs site (fenced code ok).
```python
# BEFORE (streaming)
for vec in client.embeddings.stream("model-x", text_iter):
    handle(vec)

# AFTER (batch)
batches = list(batchify(text_iter, size=16))
resp = client.embeddings.create("model-x", input=batches)
for batch in resp:
    handle_batch(batch)
```

Liam: I'll open a small SDK PR to update the sample in the examples repo (link in the PR description).

DocsBot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/345 — requested reviewers: @Maria @Liam. CI: docs-build passed :white_check_mark:.

Maria: I'll take the PR. Two asks: (1) add a short migration guide section under the changelog entry with an anchor 'how-to-migrate', (2) include a compact troubleshooting note about vector drift and recommended batch sizes.

Jin: added the migration scaffold in the PR description. Trying to keep the relnote blurb short and link to the how-to-migrate anchor for details. Public-facing wording needs to be concise.

Liam: nit: in the snippet use `batch_id` (snake_case) not `batchId` — matching SDK param naming. Also use `size=16` as an example, but comment why (latency/cost tradeoff).

Maria: will push a commit with the snippet tweaks + anchor + known-issue paragraph. ETA EOD.

Samir: SOC/CS heads: please prepare an email template for Dedicated customers. We'll give them a 90-day window and offer migration help. Tagging @Liam for proposed wording.

Maria: pushed commit 7d3f2b4 updating the example, added 'How to migrate' anchor and troubleshooting notes. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/345/files

Jin: thanks — this looks good. Once Docs CI green, I'll merge and schedule the relnote to publish with the 2026-05-01 release. :rocket:

Maria: merged and backported the snippet tweak to the examples page. Also created a small internal HOWTO for support teams: https://internal.redwood.ai/howtos/embeddings-migration (internal only).

Liam: SDK PR ready with the updated sample. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/78

DocsBot: release note item added to the staging changelog page: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/staging (preview).

Jin: great work team — tagging this thread done. If any regressions crop up during the staging build, please reopen the PR and ping here.

Maria: noted. Closing loop, thanks all :thumbsup:
